description: This file defines the AttendanceRecordAPI class for the OrangeHRM attendance plugin. It handles API operations such as retrieving and updating individual attendance records, including managing punch-in and punch-out times, overlaps, and user permissions.

classes.name: AttendanceRecordAPI
classes.description: API class handling operations for attendance records such as retrieving and updating punch-in/punch-out times, with permission checks and overlap validations.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific attendance record by ID, verifying user permissions.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing attendance record with new punch-in/punch-out details, including overlap checks and permission validations.

methods.name: isAuthUserAllowedToPerformTheActions
methods.description: Determines if the authenticated user has permission to modify the specified attendance record based on roles and ownership.

methods.name: setAttendanceRecord
methods.description: Sets punch-in and punch-out times on the attendance record after validating overlaps and timezone details.

methods.name: getRequestBodyParams
methods.description: Extracts punch-in and punch-out details from the request body parameters.

methods.name: extractPunchDateTime
methods.description: Creates a DateTime object from date/time string and timezone offset.

methods.name: isAllowedToEditTimezone
methods.description: Checks if the user is permitted to edit employee timezone information based on provided offset and timezone name.
